描述_EN: support for confucian values was important to ruling groups not themselves han chinese, striving to cement their legitimacy as holders of the mandate of heaven. this state was established by a different ethnic group from the majority han chinese. this marble slab probably came from north china, to judge from the costumes of the figures and the tent that is similar to a mongol yurt. these, together with the evidence of a complete tomb lined with such slabs excavated in the north-western province of gansu, show that the slab probably originated in jin dynasty territory. the complete set of slabs probably depicted popular confucian tales later known as the 'twenty four exemplars of filial piety'. it was during this period that this set of tales was being structured, and it often inspired tomb decoration.
描述_ZN: 对儒家价值观的支持对非汉族的统治集团很重要，他们努力巩固自己作为天命持有者的合法性。 这个国家是由一个不同于大多数汉族人的民族建立的。 这块大理石板可能来自中国北方，从人物的服装和类似于蒙古蒙古包的帐篷来判断。 这些，再加上在甘肃省西北部发掘的一个完整的墓葬内有这种石板的证据，表明这块石板可能来自金朝的领土。 整套石板可能描绘了流行的儒家故事，后来被称为 "二十四孝的典范"。 正是在这一时期，这套故事被结构化了，而且它经常激发墓葬的装饰。
